title: Runepowder Barrel
summary: Destroy to trigger a 60-ft Force blast and knockback.

fields.Activation: Action to Throw. Detonates when destroyed at 0 of its 4 HP. A throw that does not destroy it can leave it inert. A nearby blast that destroys it can trigger another detonation.
fields.Blast: 60 ft actual radius, larger than the aiming preview. Deals 10d8 + 40 Force. DC 12 Dexterity save halves damage. Creatures are knocked back 20 ft without a save.
fields.Objects: The tooltip describes a critical hit against objects and terrain. The source instead reports an extra 23 Force without doubling the damage dice.
fields.Throw: The 35 lb object needs at least Strength 9 to throw. Distance depends on Strength and weight, up to 60 ft. It can survive landing or Fire damage if its HP remains. Globe of Invulnerability blocks blast damage. The throw itself deals 1–4 Bludgeoning to the barrel. A fall of about 43 ft can deal the remaining 3 damage if impact rolls 1.
fields.Acquisition: One by Philomeen in Grymforge and two in Angleiron’s Cellar after rescuing Wulbren. If Philomeen leaves with her barrel, it may be pickpocketed or looted from her later. In Grymforge she will not give it willingly and may detonate it when alerted during dialogue.
fields.Cave-in: Its wide blast can kill Barcus and the other gnomes if used instead of the vial to clear Nere’s rockfall.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
